meta.name: architecture-boundary-enforcer
meta.description: Define and enforce module and layer boundaries such as domain/application/infrastructure separation. Use when creating or refactoring architecture.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定义并强制模块与层之间的架构边界
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中实施领域驱动设计的分层架构
copy.tagline_en: Define and enforce module and layer boundaries in your codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce domain-driven design layers in your project

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会检查代码中的模块和层（如领域、应用、基础设施）之间的依赖关系，确保没有禁止的依赖或隐藏耦合，并生成或更新 ARCHITECTURE.md 文件，列出允许和禁止的导入示例。
howto.when: 当你在创建或重构架构时，Claude 会读取项目协议和技能使用策略，收集仓库证据后执行边界检查。

say.text: 帮我检查当前代码的模块依赖是否合规。
say.note: Claude 会搜索导入并报告违规。

say.text: 更新 ARCHITECTURE.md，添加允许和禁止的导入示例。
say.note: Claude 会生成或更新架构文档。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude inspects code for module and layer boundaries (e.g., domain, application, infrastructure) to prevent forbidden dependencies and hidden coupling, and creates or updates ARCHITECTURE.md with concrete allowed/forbidden import examples.
howto.when_en: When you are creating or refactoring architecture, Claude reads the project protocol and skill usage policy, collects repository evidence, then enforces boundaries.

say_en.text: Check the current code for module dependency violations.
say_en.note: Claude will search imports and report violations.

say_en.text: Update ARCHITECTURE.md with allowed and forbidden import examples.
say_en.note: Claude will generate or update the architecture document.
